Story.title: Where it comes from. What it becomes.

earth.headline: A hundred million years in the dark.
earth.body: Deep in the mountain, heat and pressure fold minerals into stone — patient, and never made the same way twice.

unearthed.headline: Its first light.
unearthed.body: Freed from the quarry wall, the block breaks into daylight — tonnes of raw earth, lifted whole.

cut.headline: What was always hidden inside.
cut.body: The saw opens the block and the veining appears — a pattern no other slab will ever repeat.

craft.headline: Brought to life by hand.
craft.body: Under patient hands, raw becomes honed, and honed becomes a deep, mirror-still polish.

home.headline: Where it finally belongs.
home.body: It comes to rest in a kitchen, a hearth, a home — a piece of the earth, made to outlast us.

About.title: A quarry-to-container powerhouse
About.lead: Granitopia Stones International LLP is an exporter of exquisite natural stone, delivering granite, marble, quartzite and more to over 38 countries.
About.p1: From strategically located quarries across India, we select blocks for colour, grain and structural integrity — the foundation of every great slab.
About.p2: Across four manufacturing units, blocks are gang-sawn, calibrated and finished by master craftsmen and precision machines to exacting tolerances.
About.p3: Every year we process over 600,000 square metres and ship more than 1,000 containers — reliably, and on time.
About.missionBody: To bring the finest natural stone from Indian quarries to the world's most demanding projects, with uncompromising quality and service.
About.visionBody: To be the most trusted name in natural stone export — a true utopia of stone.
